title: TCA noun list
description: The work's one list: every type of a TCA package by name, kind, file and layer. Name and kind are chosen; file and layer are derived from the kind's construct page.

name.description: The type's name, as the class or composition-root callback is named.

kind.description: The construct, one of the skill's pages.

file.description: The file that holds it, relative to the package root; derived from the kind's page.

layer.description: Scalar, Value or Thing; crossing for a construct at a boundary. Derived from the kind, or for a collection or union from its file.
